stops.name: Berchtesgadener Land
stops.quote: The Berchtesgadener Land in southeastern Upper Bavaria has been designated a biosphere reserve by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).
stops.english: The Berchtesgadener Land in southeastern Upper Bavaria has been designated a biosphere reserve by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).

stops.name: high mountains
stops.quote: Our biosphere extends from the rugged high mountains to the gentle foothills of the Alps – this is unique in Germany.
stops.english: Our biosphere extends from the rugged high mountains to the gentle foothills of the Alps – this is unique in Germany.

stops.name: alpine national park
stops.quote: The core zone is protected by Germany’s only alpine national park.
